title: CodeQuest — Dashboard structure
question: Fresh hand after the re-roll: three structures, one challenger won a place. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: The Standing Wall
options.lineage: the honours board and the ledger board — headline figures first, each in its own compartment
options.thesis: The dashboard answers 'where do I stand?' before 'what's next?': six headline figures rule the top band, each one click from its record.
options.viewport: A ruled band of six figure compartments across the full width — XP, challenges completed, section, competency, boss passed, achievements — then the current challenge as one full-width directive compartment with its four-cell meta strip and action, then recent evidence.
options.risk: Dispatch sits below the figures, so the page front-loads standing over doing; and a new student's wall of zeros must still invite the first click.

options.label: The Dispatch Queue
options.lineage: the job ticket queue — numbered rows in action order, each carrying its state and its move
options.thesis: The dashboard is a triage of what you can act on: numbered rows in action order, states stamped in words, one move per row.
options.viewport: Numbered full-width rows in action order — the current challenge with its Continue action, the next challenge in line, Where to focus, and the Boss milestone — over a six-cell standing band and recent evidence beneath.
options.risk: With one active course the queue holds four rows and can feel thin; ranks must mean action order, never importance theatre.

options.label: The Open Strip
options.lineage: the ruled progress strip — the course as its own sequence of cells, the current one open
options.thesis: The course is one ruled strip of challenge cells; the open cell is the current challenge and it expands into the directive beneath it.
options.viewport: A full-width strip of thirty ruled cells grouped under section labels — completed filled with their proof tick, the current cell open in proof blue connecting down to the directive compartment — then the standing band, then recent evidence.
options.risk: Same sequence spine as the coupon strip eliminated with the last hand: it must carry position without the wallet's stamps and tabs.

options.label: The Challenge Wall
options.lineage: the convention catalog's numbered hall grid — postage-stamp cells packed edge to edge, the active one circled in pen, visited ones struck through
options.thesis: The course is a numbered wall of challenge cells; the active one is circled and expands into the directive, completed ones are struck through.
options.viewport: A packed numbered grid of the course's thirty cells in three rows of ten — the active cell circled and expanded into the directive compartment below it — over the standing band and recent evidence.
options.case: Beats the dealt three on identification — a checklist wall is the student's native register — and holds clarity: numbering keeps the sequence, strike-through states carry without colour.
options.risk: Thirty small cells must stay legible at real sizes, and the pen-circle move must read as state, never as decoration.
